output.subject: Your complaint about the paper statement fee
output.body:
Hello,

Thank you for writing to us, and please pass our thanks to your granddaughter for helping you send your message. We have received your complaint, and we want you to know it has been read carefully.

You told us that you have held your savings account with us for many years, since before we were called Meridian Harbor, and that this month you noticed a $2.00 charge labelled PAPER STMT FEE. You mentioned that nobody told you about a fee for your statement, that you do not use a computer, and that you do not want to receive your statements electronically. You asked us to take the charge off and not to charge it again.

We're sorry for the worry and frustration this has caused. Your complaint is now with a specialist team, who will look at everything you have raised, including both of your requests, and they will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for your patience, and for being with us for so long.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Greeting left without a name: in this complaint the CUSTOMER_NAME_1 token is the granddaughter who typed it, not the account holder (signed as NAME_1); add the account holder's name before sending.
Confirm whether the granddaughter is authorised on the account before discussing any account details with her.
Customer is 93 and does not use a computer; consider vulnerable-customer handling and whether a letter or phone call is a better reply channel than email.
Customer asks for the $2.00 fee to be refunded and for the fee to stop; outcome is for the reviewing team to decide, and nothing in the draft commits to either.
Check whether and how the customer was notified of the paper statement fee before it was charged.
Long-standing customer from before the bank's name change; check account history if relevant to the fee or notice.
